title: EditRules
description: Easily Edit Rules And Read Them
body:
Do /editrules to change the rules and do /rules to read them.
Have two - symbols to make new rule.
/editrules is Operator only.

/editrules command example: 
/Editrules No Hacking -- No Exploiting -- No Unfair Advantage

How The /rules Command Will Look Like:
1. No Hacking
2. No Exploiting
3. No Unfair Advantage
